plain_english_policy: This bill does not change infrastructure policy, energy regulations, or operational procedures. Its sole effect is to rename a specific segment of Alabama Highway 17 in Lauderdale County as the 'Major David Blair Faulkner Memorial Highway' and authorize officials to install commemorative markers.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would result in an honorary designation for a roadway, serving only a ceremonial purpose. It does not alter funding allocations, construction standards, or traffic laws beyond the administrative act of renaming.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors (Representatives Irons and Curtis) affirmatively advanced this resolution to honor Major David Blair Faulkner. Their sponsorship indicates support for the commemoration of his service but does not imply positions on unrelated policy issues.
evidence_quotes: DESIGNATING THE SECTION OF ALABAMA HIGHWAY 17 BETWEEN COX CREEK PARKWAY AND THE ALABAMA-TENNESSEE STATE LINE IN LAUDERDALE COUNTY THE MAJOR DAVID BLAIR FAULKNER MEMORIAL HIGHWAY.

BE IT RESOLVED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF ALABAMA, BOTH HOUSES THEREOF CONCURRING, That the section of Alabama Highway 17 between Cox Creek Parkway and the Alabama-Tennessee state line in Lauderdale County is hereby designated the Major David Blair Faulkner Memorial Highway
That a copy of this resolution be provided for presentation as a memento of this honorary designation by the Alabama Legislature.
